title: Advice machine configuration
statement: For a Boolean input word $w$, a state $q$ among four states, and a natural number $p$, define a configuration with state $q$, empty work tapes, and empty output. Its input head is at position $\min(p, |w|+1)$ among the $|w|+2$ positions, indexed from $0$.
